title: Upload Handoff Package
description: Publishes the rendered handoff package (manifests, failure tables, READMEs) from the local staging tree to gs://<bucket>/<storage_key>/. All-or-nothing: refuses to upload anything if a required file is missing or any staged file is empty, placeholder-only, or invalid JSON.

staging_dir.description: Local package tree: the shared --output_dir given to generate-handoff-manifests, generate-two-level-failure-tables and render-handoff-readmes

bucket.description: Optional GCS bucket override (else identity.bucket or $HANDOFF_BUCKET; no default)

dry_run.description: Print the gcloud copy commands without uploading
